title: Vela Sentaurus parameter IR v1
description: Lossless syntax-level intermediate representation of a Sentaurus .par parameter file, produced by scripts/sentaurus_parameter_ir.py. This IR performs no unit conversion and no physics interpretation: values keep their original lexeme and unit annotation. Blocks are an ordered array rather than a section-keyed object so that repeated sections, definition order, and #include override order all survive. Deciding which sections are active is the job of vela.sentaurus_execution_ir.v1, never of this document.

source.description: The top-level .par file, relative to the import root.

files.description: Every file that contributed lines, in first-contribution order. The first entry is always the top-level source.

blocks.description: Section blocks in source order after #include splicing. Repeated definitions are all retained; the superseded one carries shadowed_by.

unsupported_sections.description: Blocks whose section describes a model Vela does not implement. They remain in blocks so coverage can be reported honestly, but an emitter must refuse to run when one of these is active.

parse_errors.description: Always empty in a document that was successfully produced. The key exists so a consumer can assert emptiness rather than assume it; a non-empty value must make the emitter refuse to run.

section.description: The section name exactly as written, for example Bandgap or ConstantMobility.

variant.description: The quoted variant label of a named section such as QuantumPotentialParameters "theta_zero".

order.description: Position in the fully spliced source order. Equal to index; kept as a separate key so consumers do not have to rely on array position.

include_stack.description: The chain of #include sites that reached this block, outermost first. Empty for blocks in the top-level file.

shadowed_by.description: Index of a later block with the same scope, section, and variant that supersedes this one under last-definition-wins.

raw_name.description: The left-hand side exactly as written, for example dEg0(OldSlotboom) or Dop[1][1].

base_name.description: raw_name with any variant label or index removed.

variant.description: The parenthesised or quoted label, for example OldSlotboom in dEg0(OldSlotboom). This selects a model and must be matched against the execution IR before use.

indices.description: Numeric subscripts, for example [1, 1] for Dop[1][1] or [0] for efit( 0).

raw_lexeme.description: The right-hand side as written, whitespace-collapsed. Retained so a conversion can always be re-derived from the original text.

raw_unit.description: The trailing unit annotation with its brackets removed, for example cm^2/(Vs). Absent when the source carries none. This IR never converts units; it only records them.

value_kind.description: carrier_pair is the electron,hole shape that dominates .par files. empty_list is the explicit '()' spelling of an unset value.

values.description: Parsed values in source order. For numerical_table each item is one row. For record this is empty and raw_lexeme carries the content.

shadowed_by.description: Index of the later block that redefines this same parameter name.
